change: WPF acceptance now waits for Windows Update history operation to reach idle before asserting that history backup and restore buttons are enabled.
previousFailure: Two runner executions failed at the same assertion because the test checked the idle-only buttons while the history query still held the application busy. No product backup/restore failure was recorded.
limitations: CI acceptance ran on a Windows virtual machine, not every physical configuration.
The workflow does not perform real repairs, restore-point creation, driver installation, offline scan, or reboot.
No production Authenticode certificate is configured.
